sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze this graph. It requires a canonical relationship/path or equivalent verified linkage showing that each structural member's plasticStrength is the midspanPlasticCollapseLoad that produces its plasticCollapseMechanism; the current independent presence constraints are only a presence-only approximation of the required definition. Add the declared linkage and validate it with an appropriate bounded direct check, using tolerance rather than exact equality if comparing derived decimal values. The supplied dependency model lacks that needed relationship, so locate the canonical term/path with the vocabulary matcher; retain the existing ship-to-structuralMember and structuralMember-to-loadCase ownership paths and the <= comparison.
